# Traditions — synthetic fixture
# Each tree entry lists its member traditions; individual traditions follow.

# ---- Tree definitions ----

tr_discovery = {
	name = discovery
	traditions = {
		tr_discovery_exploration
		tr_discovery_scientific_method
		tr_discovery_eureka
		tr_discovery_finish
	}
	adopt_effect = "All research speed increased"
	finish_effect = "Research speed further increased and anomaly chance increased"
}

tr_expansion = {
	name = expansion
	traditions = {
		tr_expansion_frugal_expansion
		tr_expansion_world_shaper
		tr_expansion_initiative
		tr_expansion_finish
	}
	adopt_effect = "Colonization speed increased"
	finish_effect = "Pop growth speed increased"
}

# ---- Discovery traditions ----

tr_discovery_adopt = {
	tree = tr_discovery
	modifier = { all_technology_research_speed = 0.10 }
}

tr_discovery_exploration = {
	tree = tr_discovery
	cost = 100
	modifier = { ship_sensor_range_add = 1 }
	prerequisites = { }
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}

tr_discovery_scientific_method = {
	tree = tr_discovery
	cost = 100
	modifier = { science_ship_survey_speed = 0.25 }
	prerequisites = { tr_discovery_exploration }
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}

tr_discovery_eureka = {
	tree = tr_discovery
	cost = 100
	modifier = { all_technology_research_speed = 0.05 }
	prerequisites = { tr_discovery_scientific_method }
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}

tr_discovery_finish = {
	tree = tr_discovery
	modifier = {
		all_technology_research_speed = 0.10
		chance_of_anomaly = 0.10
	}
}

# ---- Expansion traditions ----

tr_expansion_adopt = {
	tree = tr_expansion
	modifier = { colonization_speed_mult = 0.25 }
}

tr_expansion_frugal_expansion = {
	tree = tr_expansion
	cost = 100
	modifier = { planet_colony_development_speed_mult = 0.15 }
	prerequisites = { }
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}

tr_expansion_world_shaper = {
	tree = tr_expansion
	cost = 100
	modifier = { terraforming_cost_mult = -0.25 }
	prerequisites = { tr_expansion_frugal_expansion }
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}

tr_expansion_initiative = {
	tree = tr_expansion
	cost = 100
	modifier = { starbase_influence_cost_mult = -0.25 }
	prerequisites = { tr_expansion_world_shaper }
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}

tr_expansion_finish = {
	tree = tr_expansion
	modifier = { pop_growth_speed = 0.15 }
}
